page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is suitable for hosting large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
